_doc: W3-B exterior district compiler spec — a 480x320 urban_core pocket immediately south of D1 Main Street's sidewalk (D1 bbox 4100,1600,1000,500 ends at world y=2100/2112 on the 16px grid). Compile with: python3 scripts/compile-exterior-district.py --spec data/city-specs/biome-specs/urban_core.json -v. Vocabulary comes from data/limezu-visual-catalog/placement-rules.json. Format: docs/EXTERIOR-COMPILER.md. Verified clear of every hand-authored district's solid stamps (d1-d16); it only touches the d00-structure base sidewalk/avenue patches (which our own surfaces repaint) and d00's auto-placed street lamps/trees (which merge-city-plan.py already prunes when a district solid lands on them) plus D11's unused grass patch underneath — see scripts/check-city-plan.py notes in EXTERIOR-MISTAKES.md for why patch-level double-painting is harmless.
district: D20 Urban Core Pocket (Main Street south extension)

compiler._doc: coords 'local': every rect/point below is relative to bbox, so relocating the pocket is a one-line bbox edit (EXTERIOR-MISTAKES.md #4).

label: MAIN STREET SOUTH

surfaces._doc: sidewalk covers the whole pocket so pass A snaps every cell to a real surface before anything is placed (no FLOATING).

surfaces.name: avenue_strip
surfaces._doc: continues the d00-structure north-south avenue (world x 4224-4288) straight through the pocket, so Main Street's own avenue does not dead-end at y=2112.

slots.name: sidewalk_edge
slots._doc: benches, bins, lamps and a couple of pole signs lining the sidewalk on both sides of the avenue strip.

slots.name: shopfront_row
slots._doc: east side of the avenue: the pinned storefront landmarks below plus scattered building_shell filler (window/door/facade singles) at medium density.

landmarks._doc: hero anchor: a 96x176 three-story glass storefront (exs.4_generic_building.generic_building_condo_5_1), tagged shop/storefront/condo.
small modular ground-floor bakery stub (16x48) beside the storefront, tagged shop/bakery.
